findings.message: At k=5, x0=0, x=1, the slope should be k·y·(1−y) = 5·0.993307·0.006693 ≈ 0.03324, so the traced slope is correct. The frame is the problem. The marker guide lines (guide.marker.x and guide.marker.y) are missing, although the marker is drawn at y≈69. The bound-x0-min capture has the same omission. The marker is drawn inconsistently across states, which the frames suggest is a clamping or omission bug. I can't tell whether the guides are meant to be hidden.
The marker callout boxes sit at y=70 and y=98. The ball is at y=69, so the callout is clamped to the top rather than centred on the marker. This is imprecise but not misleading.

The checkpoint is labelled 'Least steep' and 'Most steep', but the k values (0.2 and 5) can't be checked against the slider range from the card. The slope observation is also misleading. The steeper curve at k=5 shows a smaller marker slope (0.033) than the default (0.197), because the marker is far from the midpoint. The card never explains this, so the 'sensitivity' observation could teach that steeper means lower sensitivity. Tangent geometry can't be judged from the frames, because no tangent line object is listed in any state.

The plan requires a tangent and a Curve/Tangent legend. Frames list plot series 'Logistic' and 'Tangent' but no tangent line object. The tangent can't be verified as drawn, so the sensitivity observation is unsupported visually.
